title: LONG
text: LONG. Bought this for our cajun boil parties.  It is very long and appears sturdy.  I read a review that reported their's had broken on the first use.  I am hoping that will not be the case with mine.  It's possible there was a weakness in the handle of the one.  Wood has a nature of it's own.  I will update if there are any wear issues.  It arrived quickly (I have Prime) and in good condition.

product_metadata.title: Bayou Classic 1001 35-in Wooden Cajun Stir Paddle Perfect For Crawfish Boils and Large Batch Cooking
features: Ideal for crawfish boils and large batch cooking
description: With increasing popularity of crawfish boils and large batch outdoor cooking, the Bayou® Cajun Stir Paddle has become the must-have accessory. The sturdy 35-in wood handle stirs deep into large stockpots and jambalaya pots. Stir up fun and flavor at your next outdoor cooking party, and Let the Good Times Roll! Perfect compliment to Bayou® Boilers.
